::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## What this page does

The rolling-update builder creates an online CVD update from the approved CVD event and mortality data-release files. It freezes copies of those files with the report. The idea is that older rolling reports will remain available on the website. 

This is a one-step report publication route.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Procedure at a glance"}
1. Select the report month, two approved source data releases and report version.
2. Run the builder from the Stata menu or command window.
3. Confirm `Published successfully`.
4. Review the generated page, frozen data and source links.
5. Render and review the website before deployment.
:::

## Before you start

- Complete Step 6 for both source data releases.
- Choose the month that the update will represent.
- Start at report version 1. If the stable report version already exists, use a higher version with `replace`.
- Use source years of 2024 or later, months from 1 to 12 and a positive whole-number report version.

In the file patterns below, `YYYY_MM` is the selected data-release year and month, and `N` is the report version.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Input files"}

| File | What the builder checks |
|---|---|
| `$BNR_PUBLIC/metrics/cvd/cvd_metrics_cvd_YYYY_MM.csv` | Official public CVD event data-release file. |
| `$BNR_REPO/site/downloads/files/metrics/cvd/datasets/cvd_metrics_cvd_YYYY_MM.csv` | Website copy; its size and checksum—a value used to detect a changed file—must match the official public file. |
| `$BNR_PUBLIC/metrics/mortality/burden/datasets/mort_burden_metrics_mort_YYYY_MM.csv` | Official public mortality data-release file. |
| `$BNR_REPO/site/downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/datasets/mort_burden_metrics_mort_YYYY_MM.csv` | Website copy; its size and checksum must match the official public file. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/templates/bnr_report_update_template.qmd` | Central report template used to create the dated page. |

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Code files"}

| File | How it is used |
|---|---|
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_update_build.do` | Main builder; run directly by the menu, dialog or command. |
| `scripts/stata/dialogs/bnr_report_update_build.dlg` | Stata dialog for the report period, source data releases, version and replacement choice. |
| `scripts/stata/menu/bnr_menu.do` | Adds the rolling-update command to the BNR Stata menu. |

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Output files"}

The builder creates the official public report under `$BNR_PUBLIC/reports/cvd/updates/YYYY-MM/`.

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `index.qmd` | Generated dated report page. |
| `report.yml` | Generated report identity, version, source IDs and file checksums. |
| `data/event_release.csv` | Frozen exact copy of the selected CVD event data release. |
| `data/mortality_release.csv` | Frozen exact copy of the selected mortality data release. |

It creates the matching website report under `$BNR_REPO/site/surveillance/cvd/reports/updates/YYYY-MM/`.

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `index.qmd` | Website copy of the generated report page. |
| `data/event_release.csv` | Website copy of the frozen event data. |
| `data/mortality_release.csv` | Website copy of the frozen mortality data. |
| `$BNR_PRIVATE_LOGS/bnr_report_update_bnr_cvd_update_YYYY_MM_vN.log` | Private build and publication log. |

Only the official public package carries `report.yml`.

:::

## Build the update

1. In Stata, choose **User > BNR > Rolling three-month CVD update > Build dated online update**.
2. Enter the report year and month, CVD event data-release year and month, mortality data-release year and month, and report version.
3. Leave the higher-version replacement box unticked for the first version and select **Build update page**.
4. Alternatively, enter the complete routine command in the **Stata command window**:

   ```stata
   do "$BNR_STATA/reporting/bnr_report_update_build.do" 2026 1 2026 1 2026 7 1
   ```

5. To publish a strictly higher version at an existing month’s stable address, enter the complete replacement command:

   ```stata
   do "$BNR_STATA/reporting/bnr_report_update_build.do" 2026 1 2026 1 2026 7 2 replace
   ```

6. In `ROLLING THREE-MONTH CVD UPDATE: OPERATIONAL RUN SUMMARY`, confirm `Run status: Published successfully` and check the report ID and output locations.

## Review the update

1. Open the generated website `index.qmd` in the local Quarto preview.
2. Confirm the report month, version and both source data-release IDs.
3. Check cards, charts, coverage notes, protected values and incomplete periods.
4. Review tables, charts, explanatory text and downloads together to confirm that no protected value is shown or can be calculated.
5. Open both source-data links and confirm they name the intended data releases.
6. Check both frozen CSVs against the values displayed by the page.
7. Complete a full local Quarto render and inspect both automatic report listings.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="If the rolling update does not complete"}

| Situation | Action |
|---|---|
| An official public file and its website copy differ | Rerun the relevant Step 6 analytical publication. Do not edit either CSV. |
| Output already exists for the report month | Inspect the existing report, choose a higher version number and use the complete `replace` command. |
| A partial report lacks a consistent official `report.yml` | Inspect the complete official and website folders before recovery. Do not overwrite individual generated files. |

For other problems, see [Troubleshoot the workflow](../../maintenance/troubleshooting.qmd).

:::
